transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

Well, I guess what brought me in is... lately, I've been having these times where I just eat, and I can't seem to stop. It usually happens some nights after work, or maybe if dinner was really tense. I'll start eating, and it's like... like the decision-making part of my brain just shuts off. I can literally see myself reaching for more food, but I just can't make myself stop doing it.

After these eating episodes where you can't stop, do you do anything to try to undo what you've eaten, like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, exercising excessively, or restricting food the next day?

Yeah, I do. Um... there have been times, usually after everyone else goes to bed, where I'll go into the bathroom and make myself throw up. Or sometimes I'll take laxatives. I just tell myself it’s a way to undo the damage from eating all that food. But honestly, right afterward, I always feel really embarrassed... and physically, I get kind of shaky.
How often would you say these episodes happen where you binge eat and then purge—are we talking a few times a week, multiple times a week, or something else?

For the last few months, I'd say it's been happening most weeks. Usually, it's just one of those out-of-control eating nights a week. And then I try to make up for it... either by throwing up or taking laxatives, like I mentioned, or sometimes I'll just skip meals the next day. Or I'll force myself to go on a really long walk to try and undo it.

You mentioned this has been happening for the last few months—approximately how long have you been experiencing these binge eating and purging episodes? Can you give me a more specific timeframe, like how many months or when it started?

I'd say it's been going on for about six months now. It started right around the time an older relative came to stay with us. Having them in the house just... well, it made meals at home a lot more stressful for me, and I guess that's when all this really began.
